title: Basis items: what a file states or leaves open about its coordinate system, vertical values, datum and units, and the declared keys beneath each (E123)

items.label: Coordinate system
items.description: The map coordinate system the x and y values are in.

items.label: Vertical values
items.description: Whether the vertical values are depth, elevation or time.

items.label: Vertical datum
items.description: The level the vertical values are measured from.

items.label: Map unit
items.description: The unit of the x and y values.

items.label: Vertical unit
items.description: The unit of the vertical values; what they measure is the file's own vertical values item.

compare.exact: equal only when the stated texts are identical
compare.nfc-trimmed: equal only when identical after Unicode NFC normalisation and trimming; never case-folded or looked up

notes: An item is one quantity: two units a file declares at once are two items, and no equivalence between units.z, units.depth and units.time is inferred.
Own keys are never grouped; each file is asked for them itself.
unknown and an absent value are both unstated.
Nothing is converted: values compare as stated.
